worldcombat.skill.confuseray.summary: Fires a beam of eerie light at the target; on a hit it is left confused, so each action it attempts may be wasted and its own force turns on it when it lands a hit. The light travels in a straight line, so cover and movement can make it miss.
worldcombat.skill.confuseray.use.0: Single-target disruption from range, making a heavy hitter swing wide
worldcombat.skill.confuseray.use.1: Interrupt ranged pressure from a safe distance
worldcombat.skill.confuseray.use.2: Open a miss window before an ally's focus fire
worldcombat.skill.confuseray.description: A hit leaves the target confused for %1$s: each action it attempts has about a one-in-three chance to be wasted, and a landed hit turns its own force back on it.
Base range: %1$s blocks. Hit radius: %2$s blocks. The current range is %3$s blocks and requires a clear line of sight.

Gathering the light takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. The form is a choice: Wide reaches farther with a fatter beam but confuses for less time; Focus is shorter-ranged and slower to cast, buying a longer, heavier confusion.
Wide: reach x1.25 and a fatter beam, but confusion duration x0.75 — good for opening disruption. Focus: reach x0.75, wind-up +4 ticks and cooldown x1.15, in exchange for x1.35 confusion duration — good for pinning a target before a finish.
The partner only considers firing while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee range, larger lets it chase out for a first strike.
On a wind-up: fire only while the target attacks the partner or its owner, or right after the partner is hit, to break up the attack. Anytime: fire on any threat as pure disruption.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to fire.
